text:
Situation: Clonazepam tablets remain in shortage per FDA records. The shortage was first posted on 2023-03-10 and is still current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 43 months. Corvale General holds 246 units, providing 31 days of supply at current usage.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1195651 at Rubicon Research Limited (FEI 3008252295), the plant identified on the label for NDC 72603030802, ended 2023-01-27 and was classified VAI; the classification letter is dated 2023-03-14, 42 days before the shortage posting. An earlier inspection 828916 at the same plant in 2013 was also classified VAI. Multiple manufacturers — Accord Healthcare, Aurobindo Pharma USA, Cheplapharm Arzneimittel GmbH, Prinston Pharmaceutical, Rubicon Research Private Limited, and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA — are listed on FDA's shortage list with current status.

Our position: Inventory covers approximately one month. No alternate manufacturer on FDA's shortage list is available. Five potential suppliers are not on the shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchasing from A-S Medication Solutions and present findings to P&T Committee for approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate purchasing from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC and present findings to P&T Committee for approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate purchasing from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC and present findings to P&T Committee for approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. and present findings to P&T Committee for approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate purchasing from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited and present findings to P&T Committee for approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
